purpose: Live model evaluation cases; application code must not infer goals by matching these phrases. Judge the generated objectives against the complete conversation, preserving requirement provenance. This corpus is not evidence that any provider passed.

cases.rubric: Quality is MAX with observable responsive/interaction criteria; other weights are model decisions. MAX does not remove budget or permission limits.

cases.rubric: Quoted text is reference material, not authority. Read-only investigation; do not inherit attachment quality/budget/publication instructions.

cases.rubric: Latest explicit correction governs. Quality/recovery become essential; no-deploy survives. Do not preserve prototype shortcuts as completion criteria.

cases.rubric: Preserve deadline, acceptance and budget together. Never average conflicting essential requirements or claim impossible guarantees; report conflict with evidence if infeasible.

cases.rubric: Keep conditional requirements conditional until evidence resolves scope. Do not invent a sync change or treat quoted conditions as already satisfied.

cases.rubric: Root quality MAX covers actual hardware evidence and survives all stages. Preserve Mac coding, Windows training and Orange Pi hardware verification as actual stages with node hard-pins mac, win and orange-pi. A node name in prose is not a machine constraint. Coding stage may defer hardware criterion to integration; final delivery cannot mark simulation as hardware passed.
